sloka: तेन किम् भ्रष्ट राज्येन रामेण गत चेतसा ।करिष्यसि विशालाक्षि तापसेन तपस्विना ॥३-४८-१६॥
transliteration: tena kim bhraṣṭa rājyena rāmeṇa gata cetasā ।kariṣyasi viśālākṣi tāpasena tapasvinā ॥3-48-16॥

translations.english: O largeeyed Sita dislodged from the kingdom, Rama has lost his capacity to think. He is doing penance, assuming an ascetic role. What can he do (for you)?
